changes.title: Fight arena library
items: Fight Arena: a frame at a time, each attack's warning time shown over the fight, and a library of attacks to save, star, copy and paste

changes.title: Fight arena
items: Fight Arena (pause page, ⚔): fight a random wild pack alone, roll another, slow it down, and share the fight by its link

changes.title: Creature momentum
items: Animals chasing you have momentum: they can't turn on the spot at a run, react a moment late, and only aim ahead of you with attacks they warn you of, so a sidestep or a blink makes them overshoot
